Description.SourceString:
Observation log: NONONONONO! TURN BACK TURN BACK TURN BACK!

I have sand in every conceivable hole. I am finding new holes, thanks to the sand helpfully pointing them out. When I clean the holes, I am introducing more sand into the holes, and now I feel like cheap taxidermy.

I know you frown upon over-use of the War Room, Sir, but I needed to enact Operation Dessert Storm. We helped each other with the hole/sand situation while snacking on pastries and jellies.

I asked my comrades for volunteers: those who were willing to stay in the sands and observe. There were no volunteers Sir, which I know will disappoint, but I cannot underplay the whole friction thing. I fully understand their reticence. In the end, we had to pull straws. Again, I feel bad for those who pulled the short straws - not only because they must remain, but because their straws now have sand in them. There's no getting that out.

Threat assessment: High - we press on. Your sacrifice will be remembered forever, volunteer comrades.

End of report.

- Agent Ravioli
